title: Natural isomorphisms of exact functors descend to unbounded derived categories
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with unbounded derived categories and localization functors $Q_{\mathcal A},Q_{\mathcal B}$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $F,G:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive functors preserving finite limits and finite colimits, and let $\eta:F\xrightarrow{\sim}G$ be a natural isomorphism. Write $C(H)$ for termwise application to cochain complexes and $D(H)$ for the exact induced functor, with factorization $a_H:D(H)Q_{\mathcal A}\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_{\mathcal B}C(H)$ [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. There is a unique natural isomorphism $D(\eta):D(F)\xrightarrow{\sim}D(G)$ such that for every cochain complex $K$,
$$a_{G,K}\circ D(\eta)_{Q_{\mathcal A}K}=Q_{\mathcal B}(C(\eta)_K)\circ a_{F,K},$$
where $C(\eta)_K$ has degree-$n$ component $\eta_{K^n}$.
